processes.name: Homebuilding Process - Estate, Villas & Custom
processes.description: The 10-phase construction timeline from permitting through closing for three product types: Estate Series, Villas, and Custom homes. Each series has different durations per phase.
steps: Phase 1: Permitting and Financing Finalized (Estate: 34 days, Villas: 14 days, Custom: 24 days)
Phase 2: Foundation (Estate: 40 days, Villas: 21 days, Custom: 29 days)
Phase 3: Framing (Estate: 28 days, Villas: 11 days, Custom: 15 days)
Phase 4: Dry-In - Roof Deck, Cornice, Windows, Tile or Shingles (Estate: 45 days, Villas: 22 days, Custom: 32 days)
Phase 5: Rough-In - Plumbing, Electrical, HVAC (Estate: 28 days, Villas: 11 days, Custom: 15 days)
Phase 6: Sheetrock (Estate: 21 days, Villas: 11 days, Custom: 15 days)
Phase 7: Trim and Cabinets (Estate: 28 days, Villas: 13 days, Custom: 17 days)
Phase 8: Paint (Estate: 28 days, Villas: 13 days, Custom: 20 days)
Phase 9: Tile and Counter Tops (Estate: 28 days, Villas: 17 days, Custom: 22 days)
Phase 10: Mechanicals (Estate: 21 days, Villas: 12 days, Custom: 17 days)
Phase 11: Final (Estate: 45 days, Villas: 20 days, Custom: 25 days)
Homeowner Walk Through (Estate: 1-7 days, Villas: 1-7 days, Custom: 1-7 days)
Homeowner Closing (Estate: 7 days, Villas: 7 days, Custom: 7 days)

processes.name: Setting the Expectation with the Homebuyer - Step by Step
processes.description: Customer-facing step-by-step guide outlining the entire homebuying journey from floorplan selection through closing, move-in, and warranty. Covers contract signing, design consultation, selections, pre-construction conference, construction stages, walk-throughs, closing, and post-closing warranty.
steps: Step 1: Review floorplan choices, design options, and upgrade possibilities with Sales Executive
Step 2: Sign Residential Contract and pay 10% non-refundable deposit plus 100% of changes upfront
Receive homeowner manual including HOA information and deed restrictions
Step 3: Submit loan paperwork to applicable company with pre-approved letter for financing
Step 4: Selection Coordinator calls within 24-48 hours to set up design consultation (if applicable)
Bring pictures, samples, or anything applicable to interior or exterior scheme
If purchasing a completed home, skip to Step 9
Step 5: Depending on build time/purchase type, make selections and decide on options available
All selections must be complete prior to starting construction if building from ground up
Step 6: Pre-construction or construction conference with Sales Executive, Superintendent, and Selection Coordinator
Address all questions and concerns, review options

Step 7: Construction stages include: Pre-construction/Design/Planning, Foundation, Framing, Roof, Preparing for Sheetrock, Sheetrock, Wood Trim and Doors/Tile, Countertops and Paint, Wood Flooring and Carpet, Builder Acceptance, Homeowner Acceptance
Step 8: Sales Executive schedules walk-throughs: mechanical rough-in, audio/visual, cabinets and trim, closing walk-through, and new home orientation
Step 9: Sales Executive confirms closing date
Step 10: Loan documents drawn up from lender and issued to title company
Step 11: Move-in letter sent with detailed instructions, date/time for access
Step 12: Title Company prepares final closing statement, notifies of funds to bring, appointment set for loan signing
Step 13: Set up utilities and phone service within 3 days of closing (builder cuts off services)
Step 14: After city final inspection, home is ready
Step 15: Sales Executive schedules Homeowner Acceptance meeting - items identified as needing attention during walkthrough are repaired and ready to check
Step 16: Sales Executive schedules New Home Orientation
Step 17: Final funds brought to closing, loan documents signed
Step 18: Receive warranty manuals at closing; keys and garage door openers released upon funding
Step 19: Loan is funded
Step 20: Funds received and Deeds are recorded
Step 21: Receive title to new home
Step 22: For warranty items, log onto warranty request system - Customer Care Dept contacts within 24 hours
